Friends and acquaintances from her 
hometown came to cheer her on at the 
exhibition race Oguri Cap was running in.

Though Oguri Cap rejoices at an unexpected 
reunion, she is met with cruel words from 
the spectators.

To put the minds of those cheering for her 
at ease, Oguri Cap raced across the turf.

She scored a spectacular, overwhelming 
victory, displaying a league of difference 
between herself and the rest.
